sources.source_requirement: Beacon extracts a BodyInit and installs its resulting Content-Type. Editor draft inspected on 2026-10-10.

producer_contract: The pinned SDK serializes data as raw JSON or Base64, percent-encodes it as the sole data form member and sends a string with sendBeacon.
The standard Mixpanel hosts default to raw JSON after initialization. Caller-selected Base64 remains supported.
Track, People and Groups use the same producer. Source execution uses the pinned functions and synthetic environment stubs without network requests.

endpoint_scope.host_authority: Existing builtin supports_http host matcher must pass.
Existing builtin supports_http host matcher must pass.
Existing builtin supports_http host matcher must pass.

entity_contract.content_type: One observed text/plain Content-Type with absent charset or utf8/utf-8, matched case-insensitively.
entity_contract.body: Observable form assignment with exactly one once-decoded data member. Raw JSON and supported strict UTF-8 Base64 reach existing body contracts.
entity_contract.binary: Existing explicit binary identity/gzip decoder may supply the entity. Existing endpoint gzip policy findings remain unchanged.
entity_contract.ambiguity: Repeated or extra members, query/body data ambiguity, malformed form decoding, unsupported charset, uncertain capture metadata and recognized paired-CESU-8 SDK payloads are explicitly unvalidated.
entity_contract.legacy: Empty text, non-form text and literal JSON preserve generic handling.

owner_contract.assignment: Private capability attached only while compiling the three builtin entries.
owner_contract.selection: Both owner selection/exclusion and exact endpoint path apply before body preparation.
owner_contract.custom_plugins: Engine::new and generic register or manifest replacement receive no builtin capability. Co-selected custom owners retain legacy input and secret handling.
owner_contract.public_api: No new or modified public struct, enum or trait declaration bodies. No manifest schema capability was added.

local_inspection_limits.scope: Private SDK body inspection policy, not vendor acceptance quotas. Ordinary 2001-record Track inputs remain inspectable and reach the documented 2000-record rule.

diagnostic_contract.query: Observed query checks continue when SDK body validation is deferred.
diagnostic_contract.malformed_supported_payload: Existing vendor encoded-data errors remain applicable to demonstrably malformed supported JSON or Base64.

implementation_safeguards: Bound source parse and projection work before invoking existing vendor scopes.
Bound descendant lookup using ordered concrete path prefixes while retaining depth, spans, duplicate-key and punctuated-key behavior.
Suppress the builtin prepared data target value before findings clone a whole encoded capture.
Collect and deduplicate lexical secrets for that owner, then redact original positions in one pass. Bound secret comparisons and replacement growth before accepting the body.

authored_control_provenance.scope: Independent static source and boundary controls with original explicit selection and capture clocks. Separate from historical D1.
authored_control_provenance.prototype_corrections: An empty non-form text expectation was corrected to preserve generic handling. Unicode fixture spelling corrections and rejected resource implementations are retained in private review checkpoints; no production corpus inputs were changed.

remaining_requirements: External token/project/history and account acceptance cannot be established from one captured request.
Per-event and serialized property vendor byte limits retain unresolved unit and source-accounting gaps.
Existing profile operation precedence and Group REST versus SDK source conflicts remain inventoried.
Unknown coding chains, unavailable metadata, unrelated text and paired-CESU-8 interpretation remain outside this inspected subset.
Local bounds do not claim a general resource guarantee for every legacy input path or custom plugin.
